string-array.name: hero_mon
string-array.item: Monday — let\'s go!
New week, start with the hardest thing
Monday. Just get the engine running
Pick three things today and you win
First day of the week; a slow start still counts

string-array.name: hero_tue
string-array.item: Tuesday — the rhythm is back
We started yesterday; keep going
No rush on Tuesday, one thing at a time
Long week ahead, don\'t sprint yet
A good day to push the hard thing forward

string-array.name: hero_wed
string-array.item: Wednesday — halfway there
Halfway up the hill; catch your breath
Wednesday is the tired day. Don\'t force it
Two more days; the weekend is ahead
Half done — give yourself some credit

string-array.name: hero_thu
string-array.item: Thursday — the finish is in sight
Friday tomorrow. Hold steady
Finish today, take it easy tomorrow
A good day to wrap up, or slack off a little
One more push; almost ashore

string-array.name: hero_fri
string-array.item: Friday — the last day
Friday. Wrap up what\'s on your desk
After work today, the world is yours
Friday. Worth looking forward to
Last day of the week; leave no loose ends

string-array.name: hero_fri_evening
string-array.item: Friday night — isn\'t it exciting?
Friday night. Finally, a deep breath
Off work. No work talk tonight
Friday evening, even the wind is free
The week is over. Tonight is yours

string-array.name: hero_sat
string-array.item: Happy Saturday — today is yours
Finally the weekend. What\'s the plan?
It\'s Saturday. Slowing down is fine
Weekends aren\'t for rushing, they\'re for enjoying
No clock to punch today. Do something you like
Saturday. Sleep in as long as you like

string-array.name: hero_sun
string-array.item: Happy Sunday — give the time back to yourself
Sunday. Wrap it up gently; tomorrow can wait
No clock to punch today. Do something you like
A day with nothing scheduled
Last day of the break. Be kind to yourself
Sunday. Slowing down is fine

string-array.name: hero_holiday_new_year
string-array.item: Happy New Year — let\'s do this year together
A new year. Take it slow
New Year\'s Day — start with a day off

string-array.name: hero_holiday_new_year_eve
string-array.item: You made it through this year. See you next year
New Year\'s Eve — say goodbye to the old year
Last night of the year. Leave the regrets behind

string-array.name: hero_holiday_spring_festival
string-array.item: Happy Spring Festival — eat well, sleep well
Happy lunar new year. May the year go smoothly
Spring Festival — don\'t forget the red envelopes

string-array.name: hero_holiday_qingming
string-array.item: Peaceful Qingming. Go and see the spring
Qingming — the people we miss stay with us
A day to take it slow

string-array.name: hero_holiday_labor_day
string-array.item: Happy Labor Day — no working today
May Day — rest for a few days
Labor Day. Put the work down first

string-array.name: hero_holiday_dragon_boat
string-array.item: Peaceful Dragon Boat Festival. Easy on the zongzi
Happy Dragon Boat — watch the races if you can
The leaves smell of zongzi. Take it slow today

string-array.name: hero_holiday_mid_autumn
string-array.item: Happy Mid-Autumn — the moon and home are both here
Mid-Autumn. Have a mooncake
The moon is full; so should the family be

string-array.name: hero_holiday_national_day
string-array.item: Happy National Day — take a real break
Seven days off. Go wherever you want
National Day. Give yourself back to life

string-array.name: hero_earlybird
string-array.item: Up early — this will be a long day
Early bird. Water first
Just daylight. Do the most important thing first
Awake this early? Good form
The morning is yours. Take it slow

string-array.name: hero_nightowl
string-array.item: The night owl is back
Still awake? I\'m here
It\'s late. Finish this and sleep
Staying up is fine — just remember tomorrow
Everyone\'s asleep. It\'s just us

string-array.name: hero_care
string-array.item: Just say what you need
One sentence in, the rest is mine
What would you like me to take care of?
Have some water — no rush
Tell me what you want to finish
Rest a little if you\'re tired, I\'m here
